scope: Compose the existing MW4-MW10 Matter stack into the accepted SM1 V0 product: first prove the owner map, then bind an equipped P5 tool/action to the existing MatterMutationRequest, integrate one bounded planetary Matter bubble, transfer MatterMaterialBatch output into the canonical Item Graph, prove MW5 restart/replay, MW6/MW7/RL2/RL3 two-client convergence, and compose SM1/MW8/MW9 seam authority with MW10 only when a single mutation spans multiple Matter regions.
required_outputs: Fresh reviewed P7 Matter production owner map with zero second owners
Bounded P5 tool/action adapter to existing MatterMutationRequest/MatterExcavationService
One bounded planetary Matter bubble using existing Matter truth
MatterMaterialBatch to canonical Item Graph adapter with mass conservation
Restart/reconnect proof using MW5 and existing V0 persistence
Seam proof using SM1/MW8/MW9 and MW10 only for true multi-region mutation
Fresh review, verification and exact-head evidence before checkpoint proposal
stop_conditions: Implementation requires a second Matter/terrain truth or P7-private Matter store
Implementation requires a P7-private persistence owner, resource inventory, replication protocol or authority directory
Implementation rewrites MW4-MW10 foundation semantics instead of consuming them
Actor seam crossing is incorrectly treated as MW10 without a true multi-region Matter mutation
More than one active runtime mutation checkpoint would execute before H0.3
Exact accepted SM1 product lineage cannot be proven
risk_reasons: Mutates canonical Matter and transfers extracted mass into canonical Item Graph
Composes persistence, replication, representation and authority seam behavior
A duplicate owner or cross-region atomicity defect could corrupt world truth

design_brief.problem_statement: The accepted product can equip tools and hand players seamlessly across A/B, while the Matter program already implements mutation through MW10. The missing product capability is production integration of those existing owners on a bounded planetary surface.
design_brief.current_behavior: Matter excavation is proven in its own foundation/lab lineage; the playable V0 planetary surface does not yet route equipped-tool gameplay into that canonical Matter pipeline.
design_brief.desired_behavior: A player digs a bounded planetary Matter region with the existing MW4 contract, receives canonical material in Item Graph, all clients converge, restart preserves the hole/accounting, and seam/multi-region cases reuse SM1/MW8-MW10 without duplicate protocols.
design_brief.selected_design: Treat P7 as production convergence. Add only bounded adapters and planetary integration; preserve all existing domain owners.
alternatives_considered: Create a V0-private voxel/terrain persistence store
Route every seam-adjacent dig through a new P7 distributed protocol
design_brief.why_selected: The existing Matter stack already owns these semantics; integration minimizes new truth and preserves proven failure/recovery behavior.
expected_risks: Double accounting between removed Matter and Item Graph material
Legacy terrain/Matter overlap inside the bubble
Incorrect seam routing or misuse of MW10
Presentation lag mistaken for canonical state
validation_plan: Fresh owner-map review before runtime dispatch
Mass-conservation and Item Graph exactly-once tests
Single-region seam and true multi-region MW10 cases
Graphical two-client slice and full world/core regression
